description: This script defines command-line interface commands for translating documentation files using LLMs, managing translation files, and automating Git operations related to translating documentation in a project. It handles tasks like translating pages, listing translatable languages, managing outdated or missing translations, and automating PR creation.

methods.name: dict[str,str] get_langs()
methods.description: Caches and returns a dictionary mapping language codes to language names, loaded from a YAML file.

methods.name: Path generate_lang_path(*, lang: str, path: Path)
methods.description: Generates the path for a translated documentation file based on the language and source path.

methods.name: Path generate_en_path(*, lang: str, path: Path)
methods.description: Generates the source English documentation file path from a translated path and language.

methods.name: None translate_page( *, language: Annotated[str, typer.Option(envvar="LANGUAGE")], en_path: Annotated[Path, typer.Option(envvar="EN_PATH")], )
methods.description: Translates a documentation page into a specified language using an LLM agent, preserving the original content and updating existing translations.

methods.name: Iterable[Path] iter_all_en_paths()
methods.description: Iterates over all English documentation markdown files in a prioritized order.

methods.name: Iterable[Path] iter_en_paths_to_translate()
methods.description: Yields paths of documentation files that need translation for a specific language (excluding certain sections).

methods.name: list[str] list_llm_translatable()
methods.description: Lists all languages for which translation prompts are available, i.e., translatable languages.

methods.name: None llm_translatable_json( language: Annotated[str | None, typer.Option(envvar="LANGUAGE")] = None, )
methods.description: Outputs a JSON list of translatable languages, filtered optionally by a specific language.

methods.name: None commands_json( command: Annotated[str | None, typer.Option(envvar="COMMAND")] = None, )
methods.description: Outputs available CLI commands as JSON, possibly filtered by a specific command.

methods.name: list[Path] list_removable(language: str)
methods.description: Lists markdown files in a language directory that are removable because their English counterpart is missing.

methods.name: list[Path] list_all_removable()
methods.description: Lists removable files across all supported languages.

methods.name: None remove_removable(language: Annotated[str, typer.Option(envvar="LANGUAGE")])
methods.description: Deletes all removable documentation files for a specified language.

methods.name: None remove_all_removable()
methods.description: Deletes all removable documentation files across all languages.

methods.name: list[Path] list_missing(language: str)
methods.description: Lists documentation files missing translations for a given language.

methods.name: list[Path] list_outdated(language: str)
methods.description: Lists translated documentation files that are outdated compared to the English source, based on git commit timestamps.

methods.name: None update_outdated(language: Annotated[str, typer.Option(envvar="LANGUAGE")])
methods.description: Updates outdated translations by re-translating them.

methods.name: None add_missing(language: Annotated[str, typer.Option(envvar="LANGUAGE")])
methods.description: Adds missing translations by translating English source files into the specified language.

methods.name: None update_and_add(language: Annotated[str, typer.Option(envvar="LANGUAGE")])
methods.description: Updates outdated translations and adds missing ones.

methods.name: None make_pr( *, language: Annotated[str | None, typer.Option(envvar="LANGUAGE")] = None, command: Annotated[str | None, typer.Option(envvar="COMMAND")] = None, github_token: Annotated[str, typer.Option(envvar="GITHUB_TOKEN")], github_repository: Annotated[str, typer.Option(envvar="GITHUB_REPOSITORY")], commit_in_place: Annotated[ bool, typer.Option(envvar="COMMIT_IN_PLACE", show_default=True) ] = False, )
methods.description: Creates a GitHub pull request with the translation updates, managing branches and commits automatically.

methods.name: list[str] get_llm_translatable()
methods.description: unavailable

methods.name: None translate_lang(language: Annotated[str, typer.Option(envvar="LANGUAGE")])
methods.description: unavailable
